name: pi-session-blackboard
description: Session blackboard for the pi coding agent: branch-local session events as the authoritative memory, zero-summarizer compaction takeover after bounded memory repair, and explicit Markdown export.

scripts.build: node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc src/index.ts src/journal.ts src/summary-import.ts src/extract.ts src/export.ts src/migration.ts src/coverage.ts src/storage.ts src/board.ts src/types.ts src/paths.ts src/state.ts src/compact-assist.ts src/summary.ts src/recall.ts src/config.ts --outDir build --module NodeNext --target ES2022 --moduleResolution NodeNext --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --strict
scripts.test: npm run build && node test/smoke.mjs && node --test test/reliability.mjs test/journal.mjs test/summary-import.mjs test/runtime.mjs test/faults.mjs test/platform.mjs test/sdk-contract.mjs test/eval.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:known
scripts.release:check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:known && npm pack --dry-run
